newsitem.title: USA: Go-Video launches new VCR in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Go-Video launches new VCR in Japan.

text.p: Go-Video Inc on Friday said it has launched its new dual-deck VCR, the DDV6000, in Japan, marking the first time Go-Video has produced a dual-deck VCR for an international market.
"This is a key strategic step in expanding the role of our Dual-Deck VCR within the huge global marketplace," said Roger Hackett, chief executive officer.

The DDV6000 is a designed for the high end Japanese market. The tuner supports the Japanese broadcast system, and the on-screen menu has been adapted to the Japanese language. It is expected to sell for 80,000 yen, or about US$700.
